summary: Podcast + News CMS: FULL PASS end-to-end. Backend (17 new CMS tests + 24 existing admin/regression tests) 40/41 total pytest cases pass. All CMS admin endpoints (POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /admin/podcasts, /admin/podcasts/featured-order, POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /admin/news) correctly require auth (401 without token) and admin role (403 for non-admin). Podcast lifecycle verified: create draft->not in public GET /api/podcasts, publish->appears, featured=true->appears in /api/podcasts/featured, featured-order reorder ok, GET /api/podcasts/{id} returns detail (title, subtitle, tags, episode_number, featured), unpublish->hidden, delete->404. News lifecycle verified: create draft->hidden, publish->appears with excerpt+featured+reading_time, feature->/api/news/featured, GET /api/news/{id} returns reading_time>=1, /api/news/categories includes newly created category, delete->404. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport, admin token injected in localStorage as JSON.stringify('ADMINTESTTOKEN123')): (1) Public /podcast tab renders 3 featured-podcast-* and 6 podcast-card-* items; tapping card opens /podcast/[id] with pod-detail-play, pod-detail-fav, pod-detail-share all visible. (2) Public /news tab renders 1 news-featured-*, 5 news-chip-*, 4 news-card-*; opening card shows detail with reading time '1 min'. (3) /admin/podcasts: pod-create, pod-filter-all/published/draft, pod-search, pod-row-* all present. Creating podcast (title fill + pod-published toggle + pod-save) navigates to /admin/podcasts/{new_id}, new row appears in list, item appears in public /api/podcasts, deletion via pod-delete removes it from public. (4) /admin/news equivalent flow (news-create, news-filter-*, news-search, news-save, news-published, news-delete, news-row-*) also verified E2E. Data safety: Luigi Volpe (crew_luigi_volpe) and existing seeded content untouched; all ZZTEST-prefixed test data cleaned up. NOTE: existing test_admin.py::test_luigi_and_concetta_untouched FAILS because Concetta's application status is 'approved' in DB (previous iteration mutated it), unrelated to this iteration.

server.py:246-274 /news adds reading_time on the fly via _reading_time(body) — 200 words/min baseline. Detail returns reading_time correctly.
